analyst.summary: Balaji Amines is India's largest maker of aliphatic amines and methylamines, a specialty chemicals business that went through a severe, industry-wide down-cycle over the past two years (sales fell roughly 40% peak to trough) but has shown a clear, capacity-driven recovery in the most recent two quarters following a new plant commissioning. The balance sheet is debt-free and working capital has improved. We rate this a Hold, with more capacity still to come online that could extend the recovery.
